doc.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Meeting his wife Josephine at The Trident
summary: He met Josephine in 1967 at The Trident in Sausalito and they were living together weeks later.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Did you meet here while you were — let me do some math here.

I met her in ’67. I actually met her at The Trident, a jazz club I had played for a number of years, in Sausalito, which is just north of the Golden Gate bridge. And she came into the club one night, I’m playing there with my trio. I saw her come into the room and I said to myself this is going to be the shortest set I’ve ever played in this club. And I made a beeline for this woman. And just a few weeks later we were living together. And it’s been the best thing that ever happened to me in my life.
